quests.title: Scrap Run
quests.description: The board's standing bounty: the Guild always needs reforging stock. Bring in 3 Scrap Metal.
quests.objective: Gather 3 Scrap Metal, then turn the quest in at the board or any Reclaimers agent.

quests.title: Field Samples
quests.description: A standing request pinned to the board: the Order studies raw Aether. Bring 4 Aether Residue.
quests.objective: Gather 4 Aether Residue, then turn the quest in at the board or any Forgotten Order agent.

quests.title: Tribute of Mud
quests.description: The board posts the Monarchs' due: the mud is theirs by right. Bring 4 Aether Mud as tribute.
quests.objective: Gather 4 Aether Mud, then turn the quest in at the board or any Mud Monarchs agent.

quests.title: Grave Goods
quests.description: A quiet notice on the board: the Entombed honor their dead with offerings. Bring 5 Mud Fragment.
quests.objective: Gather 5 Mud Fragment, then turn the quest in at the board or any True Tartarian agent.

quests.title: Kindling for the Vigil
quests.description: The board's standing call: the vigil fires must never die. Bring 6 Stick for the watch.
quests.objective: Gather 6 Stick, then turn the quest in at the board or any Servants of Giants agent.

quests.title: The Dynasty's Banners
quests.description: A formal posting on the board: the empire is dressed in its colors. Bring 4 Patched Cloth for banners.
quests.objective: Gather 4 Patched Cloth, then turn the quest in at the board or any Eternal Dynasty agent.

quests.title: Dead Drops
quests.description: An unsigned note on the board: mark the safe routes. Bring 5 Small Rock for the cairns.
quests.objective: Gather 5 Small Rock, then turn the quest in at the board or any Conspiracy Architects agent.

quests.title: Quarry Quota
quests.description: The board's work-order: the Builders rebuild in stone. Bring 4 Big Rock from the field.
quests.objective: Gather 4 Big Rock, then turn the quest in at the board or any Stone Builders agent.

quests.title: Shrouds for the Faithful
quests.description: A pilgrim's notice on the board: the relics must be wrapped and carried. Bring 4 Spider Silk.
quests.objective: Gather 4 Spider Silk, then turn the quest in at the board or any Tartarian Revivalists agent.

quests.title: Salvage the buried lens
quests.description: Varakush has heard of a Relic Seeker's Lens half-buried in the Outskirts. Recover it.
quests.objective: Defeat any Aetheric creature and return.

stages.narration: Varakush slips a folded map into your hand — silt-stained at the corners. 'The lens is buried somewhere out there. Aetheric creatures guard the dig sites; cut your way through and bring back what you find.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter watches the map fold close. "The Order pays in books. Useful books."

stages.narration: A hum from somewhere south — the lens reading the air around you, even buried. Aetheric resistance grows the closer you draw to the dig site.
You unearth a crystalline disc the size of a saucer. Faint geometry visible through the silt — the Relic Seeker's Lens. Bring it back to a Forgotten Order agent.

quests.title: Field a scholar
quests.description: Travel to two new locations and bring back what you saw.
quests.objective: Discover 2 locations.

stages.narration: The scholar hands you a slim travel ledger and three sharpened pencils. 'Walk. Note. Return. The Order remembers what walkers tell us.'
You note the first place — wind direction, sky color, what you heard. The page fills more than you expected.
Second location, second entry. The ledger is starting to feel like something the Order will actually read.

quests.title: Run the haul
quests.description: The Guild needs 100 TC worth of relic salvage. Deliver, no questions asked.
quests.objective: Reach 100 TC, then complete the quest.

stages.narration: The Reclaimer hands you a delivery slip — blank line for what you bring, signed by the Guild's broker. 'Anything sellable. Don't ask. We don't.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter says nothing. The Guild prefers it that way.

stages.narration: Coin gathers in your pack faster than you expected. The broker's slip is half-filled.

quests.title: Pinch from the Monarchs
quests.description: Steal something from a Mud Monarchs vendor without being caught.
quests.objective: Steal successfully from any vendor.

stages.narration: The Reclaimer's voice drops. 'A Mud Monarchs vendor. Anything they're not watching. Bring it back.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter's gaze sharpens. "The Monarchs remember faces. Cover yours."

stages.narration: You feel eyes on you wherever Monarch silver shows. The opportunity will come once.

quests.title: Walk the buried road
quests.description: Make a pilgrimage to a buried capital — every True Tartarian who matters has done it.
quests.objective: Travel 5 times.

stages.narration: The elder traces a finger across an old map. 'The road goes where the ground forgets it. Walk it. We will know.'
Your boots find the first stretch of buried road — the silt is firmer here, packed by the dead before you.
Half-way. The wind off the buried capital smells like rust and old incense.
The towers rise out of the mud-flats — not all the way, but enough to call it a city. You have walked the road. Return to any True Tartarian agent.

quests.title: Cut down a rare beast
quests.description: The enclave hears you. Prove you fight like one of them.
quests.objective: Defeat a Rare or Legendary enemy.

stages.narration: The Giant elder hands you a stone token. 'When you take down something Rare or worse, bring the token back. We will know what to do with it.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter notes the weight of the token. "A small thing the Giants take seriously."

stages.narration: The token warms in your pack — the elder's mark hums when there's a Rare creature in range. Hunt accordingly.

quests.title: Silence a rediscoverer
quests.description: Someone has been talking about Tartaria where they should not. End the conversation.
quests.objective: Defeat 3 enemies.

stages.narration: The Monarch agent's voice is flat. 'Three names. Three silences. You don't have to know why. We do.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter's eyes go cold. "The Monarchs name the silenced. We do not."

stages.narration: One down. The agent's network confirms — a name struck from somewhere you'll never see.
Two. The work goes faster than feels comfortable.
Three. Return to any Monarch agent for the seal.

quests.title: Tribute at the Vault
quests.description: Walk the road to the Giant Vault and leave an offering at its threshold. The Giants are sleeping — the Servants ask only that we keep the path warm.
quests.objective: Travel to the Giant Vault and leave tribute.

stages.narration: The Servant presses a small carved stone into your palm. 'This is the tribute. Carry it to the Vault. Set it on the threshold. Do not enter. We will know.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter watches the stone. "What sleeps is not asleep because nothing is happening. It is asleep because we agreed not to wake it."

stages.narration: The road has narrowed. You can feel the weight of the carved stone in your hand — heavier than it has any right to be. The path forward feels older than the maps say it should.
The Vault rises ahead. Stone fitted by no living mason. You set the tribute on the threshold and step back. The hum that meets your palm is not a sound.

quests.title: Reclaim a Dynasty seal
quests.description: An oath-stone bearing the Eternal line's seal was carried off into the ruins. Bring it home.
quests.objective: Cut through the looters and recover the seal.

stages.narration: A herald presses a writ into your hand. 'The seal is dynastic property. Whoever holds it dies a thief.'
Armed looters guard the cache where the seal was last seen.
You lift the oath-stone from the rubble, the seal still warm. Return it to the Dynasty.

quests.title: Silence a pretender
quests.description: A rival claimant is raising a banner against the Eternal Dynasty. End it before it spreads.
quests.objective: Scatter the pretender's followers.

stages.narration: 'A false heir,' the herald says flatly. 'The oaths do not bend. Make sure his do not either.'
The pretender's sworn swords close ranks around him.
The banner comes down. The Dynasty's claim stands unchallenged — for now.

quests.title: Clear the unstable works
quests.description: A dig site is crawling with reactivated constructs. The Builders can't survey it until it's quiet.
quests.objective: Destroy the rogue constructs.

stages.narration: A foreman rolls out a chalked plan. 'We can't measure a thing while those things are walking. Put them down.'
Aethercraft constructs lurch between the shoring timbers.
The site falls silent. The surveyors can finally work. Report back.

quests.title: Recover a regulator core
quests.description: A pre-flood regulator core would let the Builders cycle a dead engine. It's guarded.
quests.objective: Defeat the automatons and bring the core back.

stages.narration: 'One regulator,' the foreman says. 'The Nexus runs on nine of them. This is practice.' He marks an X on the plan.
Sentinel automatons ring the core housing.
You pry the regulator loose. It hums faintly in your pack. Bring it to the Builders.

quests.title: Burn an evidence trail
quests.description: Someone's been connecting dots the Architects buried. Erase what they found.
quests.objective: Eliminate the snoops at the cache.

stages.narration: A handler slides you a dossier across the false rubble. 'They saw too much. The map-wall must never leak.'
Hired guards protect the leaked documents.
The trail goes cold. The dots stay unconnected. Return to the Blind.

quests.title: Sever a connected dot
quests.description: An informant is one conversation from blowing the whole conspiracy. Cut the line.
quests.objective: Break through the informant's protection.

stages.narration: 'A dot that connects to nine others,' the handler murmurs. 'Sever it cleanly.'
The informant's hired muscle stands between you and the line.
Silence. The web holds. The Architects breathe easier — quietly.

quests.title: Stage a recovery
quests.description: The Revivalists need a clean, photogenic recovery. Clear the dig of anything that bites.
quests.objective: Clear the creatures from the dig site.

stages.narration: A field organizer hands you a schedule. 'Press at noon. The site has to be safe and the relic has to be dramatic.'
Wasteland creatures have nested in the exposed ruin.
The site is clear and camera-ready. Bring back the find for the front page.

quests.title: Bring back a front-page relic
quests.description: One artifact the surface world can't ignore. Fight to it and carry it out.
quests.objective: Recover the headline relic.

stages.narration: 'By Capital five the Revival is the headline,' the organizer grins. 'This is Capital one. Make it loud.'
Guardians of the ruin do not want their treasure publicized.
You haul the relic into daylight. The cameras will love it. Bring it in.

quests.title: Plant the Monarch standard
quests.description: A holdout refuses the Monarchs' writ. Make the standard fly over their ground.
quests.objective: Break the holdout's defenders.

stages.narration: A seneschal hands you a furled banner. 'Where this flies, the family rules. See that it flies.'
The holdout's defenders mass at the gate.
The standard rises over taken ground. The Court will be pleased.

quests.title: Keep the vigil
quests.description: Grave-robbers are disturbing a Giant's tomb. The Servants cannot allow it.
quests.objective: Drive off the tomb-disturbers.

stages.narration: A keeper pours a libation. 'The Giant must not be woken in anger. Send the robbers away — or send them down.'
The grave-robbers fight to keep their dig.
The tomb is quiet again. The vigil holds. Return to the shrine.

quests.title: Earning the Guild's Rate
quests.description: Anyone can sell the Guild scrap. A real partner brings something that matters. Lay a Golem Core on the bench and the quartermaster will cut you the members' rate — proper prices, coming and going.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Reclaimers Guild agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: The Order's Confidence
quests.description: The Order deals openly only with those who prove their worth. Bring them a Golem Core — a working relic of the old machine-craft — and they'll open their real ledger to you.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Forgotten Order agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: A Seat at the Table
quests.description: The Monarchs haggle hard with strangers. Hand their steward a Golem Core as tribute and you stop being a stranger — their stalls will deal you fair terms from then on.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Mud Monarchs agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: Proven Worthy
quests.description: The True Tartarians trust few. Recover a Golem Core and lay it before them as proof you can be relied on — and their traders will price you as one of their own.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the True Tartarians agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: The Vigil's Favor
quests.description: The Servants keep their best goods for the devoted. Offer a Golem Core to the vigil and they'll count you a friend — friends pay less, and are paid more.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Servants of the Giants agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: The Magister's Regard
quests.description: The Dynasty's magisters do not bargain with just anyone. Present a Golem Core and Caul Veyre will extend you the court's rate — a courtesy, for a courtesy.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Eternal Dynasty agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: Into the Circle
quests.description: The Architects deal in secrets and rarely in favors. Bring the Cartographer a Golem Core and you buy your way into the inner circle — where the prices are the real ones.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Conspiracy Architects agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: Raised in Their Esteem
quests.description: The Builders respect what powers their works. Deliver a Golem Core to the foreman and they'll raise you in their books — better stock, better coin, both directions.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Stone Builders agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: A Believer's Terms
quests.description: The Revivalists reserve their kindness for the faithful. Carry them a Golem Core, a spark of the old world reborn, and Sister Ashfall will see you dealt with generously.
quests.objective: Obtain a Golem Core, then hand it to a the Tartarian Revivalists agent in person to earn their dealing rate (Charisma-scaled discounts).

quests.title: The Survey Line
quests.description: Three Stone Builder surveyors need to walk their chain-and-transit line home through open silt. The waste does not care about their instruments.
quests.objective: Escort the surveyors safely back to a Stone Builders agent. If the party is cut down, the contract fails.

quests.title: Pilgrims of the Buried Road
quests.description: Two pilgrims of the Order mean to walk the buried country and arrive breathing. Faith stops mud, not blades.
quests.objective: Escort the pilgrims safely to a Forgotten Order agent. If the party is cut down, the contract fails.

quests.title: The Envoy's Road
quests.description: A Dynasty envoy travels with sealed terms and no sword arm. What the seal is worth, others have already guessed.
quests.objective: Escort the envoy safely to an Eternal Dynasty agent. If the envoy falls, the contract fails.

quests.title: Scholars Into the Ruins
quests.description: Two Revivalist scholars want to read the old stones with their own eyes. The road between them and the stones has opinions.
quests.objective: Escort the scholars safely to a Tartarian Revivalists agent. If the party is cut down, the contract fails.
